subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should verified GitHub Copilot Responses models automatically switch to provider-native web search when the account capability is enabled and no managed search provider is explicitly pinned?
rationale: The patch is correct and preserves explicit managed routes, but it intentionally changes upgrade-visible default behavior for eligible existing users; code review cannot choose that provider product contract.

options.title: Approve gated automatic routing
options.body: Use Copilot-native search only when the real account capability and verified live model both support it, while preserving explicit managed providers and denied-policy fallbacks.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep managed search as the upgrade default and add a provider-owned explicit selection before Copilot-native search activates.

options.title: Retain managed-only behavior
options.body: Decline the automatic route change and leave Copilot models on the current managed search path.

recommendation.title: Approve gated automatic routing
recommendation.body: Use Copilot-native search only when the real account capability and verified live model both support it, while preserving explicit managed providers and denied-policy fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of the shared provider stream and Copilot payload path makes this the strongest available decision-routing signal.
